approvalScope.description: Approval with conditions for later staged Stage 2 runtime realization of Revision-Targeted Case Publication and Learner Exposure only. This authority record does not implement runtime code.

approverAuthority: Founding Architecture Authority bootstrap authority for bounded WEOS runtime governance realization after APP-006 exact CaseRevision approval and APP-007 CaseRevision mutation hardening
rationale: WEOS requires publication and learner exposure to target an exact approved CaseRevision rather than mutable Case material or scheduler state. APP-006 approved governed approval of an exact CaseRevision. APP-007 implemented controlled CaseRevision creation and mutation hardening, and remains a prerequisite governance package for publication work while pending independent review. This bounded authority permits later APP-008A through APP-008D implementation of revision-targeted Case publication, DailyCase publication binding, GameSession revision-bound exposure, and attempt provenance/legacy hardening without authorizing runtime changes in this authority package.
conditions: APP-008 is separate from APP-006 and APP-007: APP-006 governs approval of an exact CaseRevision, APP-007 governs controlled CaseRevision creation and mutation hardening, and APP-008 governs later publication and learner exposure of an exact approved revision.

APP-008 depends on APP-006 exact CaseRevision approval and APP-007 CaseRevision mutation hardening; APP-008A must treat APP-007 independent-review closure or an explicit human waiver as a prerequisite before runtime implementation proceeds.

approval is not publication, publication is not scheduling, Case is not CaseRevision, canonical governance records are not compatibility projections, and historical exposure must not fabricate governance history.

the canonical publication unit must identify Case, exact CaseRevision, APP-006 approval evidence, material/content context, actor, authority evidence, readiness assessment, decision time, effective time, standing, and derived learner exposures.

clinically material learner content must be reproducible from the published revision and publication context; APP-008A must classify stable content versus presentational metadata before implementation and must not blindly snapshot the entire DiagnosisRegistry.
publication readiness must be revision-specific and computed as READY or BLOCKED with explicit blockers and warnings; READY_TO_PUBLISH remains a compatibility or workflow projection only.
runtime route access, technical role, scheduler execution, DailyCase assignment, or visible UI state must not create publication authority.

publication commands must declare expected CaseRevision identity, expected APP-006 approval identity, expected material context or content hash, expected validation identity or context when applicable, expected publication standing, authority assignment, idempotency key, and canonical command fingerprint.
later runtime implementation must evaluate publication preconditions atomically with decision persistence and compatibility projection updates.
publication lifecycle terms are AUTHORIZED, WITHDRAWN, and SUPERSEDED; decision state, effective state, schedule state, and learner exposure state remain distinct.
authorizing a later revision must not erase, rewrite, or retroactively alter historical exposure for an earlier revision.
future DailyCase binding must preserve Case identity while adding exact CaseRevision and publication-decision identity for newly governed learner exposure.
historical DailyCase rows remain legacy-compatible unless exact revision and publication evidence are provable through committed runtime data.
future GameSession binding must preserve the exact revision exposed to the learner; mutation or newer revision publication must not alter content already seen in a session.
future learner hydration must use revision-bound published content after the APP-008C cutover, while legacy sessions remain explicitly classified.
APP-008D must decide whether Attempt stores direct CaseRevision identity or derives it from GameSession; APP-008 does not mandate direct Attempt revision storage.
legacy and backfill handling must be additive only; no fabricated historical decisions, actors, authority assignments, publication decisions, or revision exposure records may be created.
exact legacy revision backfill is permitted only when provable from existing runtime data; otherwise records must retain explicit null or legacy classification.
DailyCase, GameSession, Attempt, leaderboard, XP, and historical gameplay records must not be destructively rewritten without separate approved authority.

APP-008 authorizes only later staged work named APP-008A revision-targeted publication governance, APP-008B DailyCase revision/publication binding, APP-008C GameSession revision binding and revision-bound hydration, and APP-008D attempt provenance and legacy hardening.
APP-008A must precede APP-008B; APP-008B must precede canonical learner-read cutover in APP-008C; APP-008D must not fabricate historical provenance.

excluded from this authorization are destructive Case replacement, compatibility field removal, automatic publication after APP-006 approval, scheduler-created publication authority, autonomous AI publication, fabricated legacy governance, broad Diagnosis Education publication redesign, Teaching Rule publication redesign, graph publication redesign, generic cross-artifact publication framework beyond the Case vertical slice, destructive historical migration, unrelated editorial workspace redesign, and any runtime implementation in this authority package.

bootstrapAuthority.scope: Stage 2 runtime implementation authorization only for later revision-targeted Case publication and learner exposure through APP-008A, APP-008B, APP-008C, and APP-008D. This record authorizes staged future implementation but creates no runtime code, schema migration, scheduler change, DailyCase binding change, GameSession binding change, Attempt provenance change, learner-facing API change, publication execution, backfill, repair, or destructive migration by itself.
bootstrapAuthority.expiryCondition: Expires when permanent runtime governance authority supersedes this pilot authorization, or when implementation extends beyond the named Case publication and learner-exposure APP-008A through APP-008D sequence without a separate approved authorization.
